responsibility: Provides the AVX-512 VBMI2 + AVX-512VL intrinsic layer for 128-bit and 256-bit compress/expand and packed double-shift operations. It covers the VL-sized forms of byte/halfword compressstore, compress, expand, expandload, and variable/immediate shld/shrd operations, with a second feature-gated section for AVX512BW-dependent byte operations, making it the narrower companion to avx512vbmi2intrin.h.
